GRANT PROXY ON CURRENT_USER TO CURRENT_USER WITH GRANT OPTION
CREATE DATABASE d
USE d
CREATE TABLE t(a INT)
CREATE USER u
GRANT ALL ON TABLE * TO CURRENT_USER(),missing_user,missing_user
GRANT ALL ON TABLE * TO missing_user,missing_user
GRANT ALL ON TABLE * TO u,missing_user,u
GRANT ALL ON TABLE * TO missing_user,u,missing_other
GRANT ALL ON TABLE * TO CURRENT_USER(),CURRENT_USER()
GRANT ALL ON TABLE d.t TO CURRENT_USER(),missing_user,missing_user
GRANT ALL ON TABLE d.t TO missing_user,missing_user
GRANT ALL ON TABLE d.t TO u,missing_user,u
GRANT ALL ON TABLE d.t TO missing_user,u,missing_other
GRANT ALL ON TABLE d.t TO CURRENT_USER(),CURRENT_USER()
GRANT ALL ON *.* TO CURRENT_USER(),missing_user,missing_user
GRANT ALL ON *.* TO missing_user,missing_user
GRANT ALL ON *.* TO u,missing_user,u
GRANT ALL ON *.* TO missing_user,u,missing_other
GRANT ALL ON *.* TO CURRENT_USER(),CURRENT_USER()
SHOW GRANTS FOR u
SHOW GRANTS FOR CURRENT_USER()
DROP PROCEDURE IF EXISTS p
CREATE PROCEDURE p() BEGIN DECLARE a INT; SET GLOBAL autocommit=1,a=2; END
DROP PROCEDURE IF EXISTS p
CREATE PROCEDURE p() BEGIN DECLARE a INT; SET a=1,GLOBAL autocommit=1,a=2; END
DROP PROCEDURE IF EXISTS p
CREATE PROCEDURE p() BEGIN DECLARE a INT; SET GLOBAL a=1; END
DROP PROCEDURE IF EXISTS p
CREATE PROCEDURE p() BEGIN DECLARE a INT; SET @@GLOBAL.a=1; END
